name: Bold Red Chilaquiles by Old El Paso®

ingredients.name: taco kit (includes shells, sauce, and seasoning packet)

instructions.primary_message: Break the Old El Paso® taco shells into roughly 1-inch pieces. Place them in a large bowl and toss with the two included taco sauce packets.

Heat a medium skillet over medium-high heat. Add 2 tbsp of oil to the pan. Once warm, quickly cook the taco sauce-soaked tortilla pieces for approximately 2 minutes, stirring until golden and crispy. Divide the cooked chips between two plates.

In the same pan, without cleaning it, add the remaining oil and fry the eggs to your preference (1–2 per person). Once cooked, place the eggs on top of the chips. Garnish with onion, cilantro, avocado, and cotija. Serve with sour cream on the side. Finish by squeezing lime juice over the top and seasoning the egg yolks with salt. Serve immediately.
